CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (color positions), an explicit presentation/organization (coordinate listings and layout), and a distinct origin/status field are present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report identifies content (color-labeled positions) with explicit attributes (red, blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an explicit origin/status field for the same referent, distinguishing identification from record/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented/organized via spatial layout and explicit coordinate listings.
